notes.title: Bug fix release.
notes.content:
Bug fixes, including:

- Mouse input in some UI screens/elements not recognized.
- Minor UI fixes for the (experimental) debug view.
- Fixes for a bunch of things that led to unnecessary log files; from the user perspective this would look like a minor perf fix.

If you have any issues, please report them to the forum. The game uses the Unity Bug Reporter to collect crashes automatically, but if you have any non-crashing issues I can't start to fix them unless they are reported.  Especially things that I can't easily replicate, like "German text looks strange on my Turkish system."   :)

Thank you for all of your support!

notes.title: Mouse Support!
notes.content:
tl;dr - if you prefer to play with keyboard and mouse, this release is for you!

BlazeSky is, in many ways, a dual-stick shooter. I expected most people to play with a game controller, not a keyboard and mouse. Watching streamers play the game, it became painfully obvious that a lot of people prefer keyboard and mouse. This release adds proper mouse support, making keyboard and mouse a first-class option.

Notable Features & Enhancements:


 The mouse can now be used to fire the turrets, activate items, and zoom in and out with the scroll wheel.
 Many bug fixes related to the control mapper/customizer.
 Added the photo mode button to the game controller by default.
 Save files are now written to a folder on disk, instead of the player preferences. This will (shortly) allow for Steam Cloud save support. Unfortunately, it does mean you will lose your save files. As nobody has access to the game right now except for early testers... so it goes.
 All story dialog and new, updated barks have been added to the game. New jump in/out SFX. New engine SFX.
 A debug mode has been added. Add the entry "-debug 1" to the launch options to see it. Hopefully you shouldn't need it at all, but if the game isn't launching on low end hardware it might be helpful to diagnose what's going on.
 Google Translate versions of the game are now available in eight languages. I think I found a bug where if the game was launched on a not-supported locale (e.g. Swedish) it would hang on launch - if you have a non-English machine (either supported or not), please give it a whirl and let me know. The game should launch, attempt to auto-detect your language and switch to that if available, defaulting to English.
 Shipyard now shows more detailed statistics for equipped items.
 Merchants now show the delta between the currently equipped item and the item being offered.
 Added "fog" to certain areas (e.g. particle fields, comets, final boss areas).
 The game now includes endings for all of the main missions. Endings for all five main mission givers unlock after the Big Boss encounter - you can complete them in any order.

notes.title: Voice Actors, Preview for Eight Languages
notes.content:
Several characters now have preliminary voice actors added (not all, yet). The audio is currently being reworked and remixed. For example, music will eventually fade out when dialog is spoken, that's not quite in yet.

All of the game text with the exception of the main story missions is now "translated" via Google Translate. This is a first step toward full localization - once the voice actors are done, the final script is locked. Then there will be a Google Translate pass, and finally a native speaker pass.

Here are the new work-in-progress languages:

- Spanish
- French
- Italian
- German
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Simplified Chinese

If you happen to speak one of those languages, give it a try!

There have been a lot of other updates, including:

- Diagnostics button under settings (to assist with trouble shooting & bug reporting)
- Merchants now will show statistics and deltas when compared with the currently equipped item
- Fonts for many HUD elements are now larger and much easier to read
- Quest HUD destination icons are now thicker/clearer

As always, if you run into any issues please let report at https://doublerobot.com/contact - and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Lots of fixes and improvements. Notable improvements include dynamic UI support for keyboard, XBox One, and PS4 controllers - play with just a keyboard on your laptop, plug in a controller and the UI will automatically switch to the controller.

Other updates:

- There are now three save slots. Great for testing, or if you have more than one player on your account.
- Fixes for the opening scene. Still not final, but should work with any aspect ratio.
- Multiple aspect ratio support - 4:3, 16:9, 16:10, 2:1 or some other kind of monitor? All UI elements should work fine now.
- In-game cursor. Sometimes it's the little things.
- Lots and lots of other UI, visual, and perf changes. 
- You can now configure settings in the initial launch screen, including setting visuals to Ultra with no vsync. 
- Currently seeing 100-400fps on a Windows laptop with a 1060 NVIDIA video card, so that seems to be coming along nicely. There were a few places (e.g. certain nebula effects) with a lot of particles that were causing slowdowns - all of those should be fixed now.
- We are preparing to add professional voice acting to the game. The final script revision is locked - you may notice a few places where the temp audio doesn't match the final text, specifically Barnes in the opening and possibly a few barks. That's temporary! :)

As always, if you run into any issues please let report at https://doublerobot.com/contact - and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Updated Dialog System
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36880361/8e27d81f2890df5532ce46d2d6b5687391868451.jpg

All of the dialog with NPCs now features player response icons. These icons help clarify the differences between the response for the player. Eventually, these icons will also be linked to (some level) of game system logic.

This is part of the overall process of finalizing the NPC dialog in the game. The path is a) finalize the script, then b) record the voice actors and then c) localize the script into one or more additional languages.

It would be *really* helpful if you would report any issues with the script or dialog. Anything from a typo to something confusing would be great.

There are also lots of minor updates and tweaks - too many to list, but here's a few:

- Lots and lots of audio fixes, including a lot of missing loop regions (that's why the music just... disappeared a lot).  Also a bunch of fixes for barks, including some logic fixes (e.g. mines no longer sound like the organic aliens).
- Updated (but still not done yet) final boss battles
- Bug fixes (but still not done yet) opening cinematic refresh
- Aspect-ratio independent UI. Should work on pretty much any window size - heck, you could play portrait in theory.
- Decreased complexity of nebula particle effects for perf

Thank you for your support!
